newsitem.title: UK: M.A.I.D DIPS AFTER H1 RESULTS DISAPPOINT.
newsitem.headline: M.A.I.D DIPS AFTER H1 RESULTS DISAPPOINT.

text.p: Shares in electronic information provider M.A.I.D Plc slipped on Thursday as investors took profits following the company's half year results which were below expectations, dealers and analysts said.
M.A.I.D shares eased 4p to 211p by 0756 GMT in volume of 234,000 shares.
"The stock had a good run earlier in the week before the results and now people are taking profits," said one dealer.
M.A.I.D made a pre-tax profit of 1.9 million stg in the six months to June 30 on turnover of 14 million stg.
Alistair King, analyst at brokerage Charles Stanley, said the turnover figure was disappointing but remained a long-term buyer of the stock.
"I feel a little uneasy about the stock in the short-term but the shares look cheap," King said.
After reporting its half year results, M.A.I.D said it had acquired a 70 percent share of Muscat Ltd, a Cambridge-based retrieval technology vendor for around 5.5 million stg.
